notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY, STICKY CLICKER!
notes.content:
Sticky Clicker is 1 year old!!
It's hard to believe that just a year ago on April 19th I uploaded Sticky Clicker to Steam. Thank you everyone immensely for the support! More things will come to Sticky Clicker in the future...

Now, for the update!

Additions:

Added 2 new upgrades
Gave Sticky a party hat
Added 2 new achievements


Fixes:

Fixed a bug where not all skins were shown


That's all! Thanks again everyone for 1 year of clicking stickies! Here's to another!

imcool123

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
1.1 is here! Here's the changelog:


Added saving
Added 2 new buttons (Particle Accelerator, Carpal Tunnel Cream (thats an original idea by the way))
Added a points per click/second counter
Added a visual counter for how much of a building you own

And that's it! Enjoy clicking Sticky!
